jobs.description:
About Us LandOffer.ai
is an early-stage AI startup building an AI-powered job search and application platform
designed to help job seekers land more interviews and offers with less effort.
We're reimagining the job search experience with intelligent AI agents that help users discover relevant opportunities, tailor their resumes, automate job applications, and track their progress — all in one place.

We're looking for a Full-Stack Engineer
to join our early team and help build the next generation of AI-powered career tools.

This role is ideal for someone passionate about AI, automation, and building products from 0 → 1
, who thrives in fast-moving startup environments and wants to make a meaningful impact.

To be considered, please explore
LandOffer.ai and share one idea on how we could improve the product or user experience.

What You'll Do Design, build, and ship full-stack features from concept to production.
Develop and integrate AI agents, LLM-powered workflows, and automation tools
.
Build scalable backend services, APIs, and intuitive frontend experiences.
Work on browser automation, job application workflows, and Chrome extension features.
Collaborate directly with the founding team on product strategy and technical decisions.
Continuously improve product performance, reliability, and user experience.
Help shape our engineering culture and technical architecture from the ground up.

What We're Looking For 1+ years of software development experience (including internships or meaningful projects).
Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, and Python
.
Experience with databases, REST APIs, and modern web development.
Familiarity with LLMs, AI agents, or AI-powered applications
.
Understanding of system design, deployment, and cloud infrastructure.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.
A builder mindset — resourceful, proactive, and comfortable moving fast.
Experience with AI agent frameworks, LangChain, or similar tools.
Experience with browser automation (Playwright, Puppeteer) or Chrome extensions.
Familiarity with LLM APIs, RAG, and agentic workflows.
Experience building and launching products at early-stage startups.

Why Join Us? Early Impact:
Join at an early stage and directly influence the product and technology.
Ownership:
Take full responsibility for features from ideation to launch.
Build with AI:
Work on real-world applications of AI agents and automation.
Fast Growth:
Learn, experiment, and ship in a fast-moving startup environment.
Meaningful Mission:
Help job seekers spend less time applying and more time preparing for opportunities that matter.

If you're excited about the future of AI agents and job search automation
, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply directly or DM us to chat. Let's build the future of job searching together.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

The TikTok U.S. Data Security (USDS) team is responsible for the security, integrity, and compliance of TikTok data in the United States. The Data Platform Team builds reliable and cost-efficient infrastructure, self-service tools, and data products that help business and engineering teams work effectively.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to grow their backend engineering skills while contributing to AI-powered internal products. You will work on clearly scoped projects with guidance from experienced engineers, learn the team’s systems and development practices, and gradually take ownership of production-ready components.

Responsibilities
- Implement, test, and maintain well-scoped backend services, APIs, and internal platform components with guidance from experienced engineers.
- Contribute to AI-powered product capabilities such as data services, workflow automation, model integrations, and internal tools by following established designs and engineering practices.
- Work with engineers, data scientists, and business partners to understand requirements, clarify edge cases, and deliver practical solutions.
- Write clear, maintainable code and participate in code reviews, design discussions, testing, deployment, and production support.
- Learn the team’s architecture, development processes, and operational standards, and apply feedback to improve technical judgment and execution.
- Take increasing ownership of small features or components, communicate progress and blockers early, and deliver work within agreed scope and timelines.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, completed recently or expected before the start date.
- Programming foundations: Proficiency in at least one backend programming language such as Python, Go, Java, or Node.js, demonstrated through coursework, internships, research, or personal projects.
- Computer science fundamentals: Understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented or functional programming, and basic software design principles.
- Backend fundamentals: Familiarity with APIs, databases, testing, version control, and common client-server concepts.
- Learning and collaboration: Ability to learn unfamiliar systems, ask clear questions, incorporate feedback, and work effectively with teammates.

Preferred Qualifications
- AI Systems Exposure: Coursework, internship, research, or project experience using LLM APIs, RAG pipelines, model-serving tools, or agentic workflows; interest in learning how to build reliable and safe AI-powered systems.
- System Design Foundations: Understanding of modular design, API design, testing, and maintainable code, with the ability to discuss basic trade-offs and apply feedback from experienced engineers.
- Collaboration and Growth: Strong communication and teamwork skills, curiosity about user needs, and the ability to take ownership of well-scoped tasks or small features with appropriate guidance.

About USDS

TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

USDS Reasonable Accommodation

USDS is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/USDS-RA​

The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $100320 - $177840 annually.​
Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.​
Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short-term and long-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure).​
The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.​
For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates:​
Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our company believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment:​
1. Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues;​
2. Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and​
3. Exercising sound judgment.​

Cleveland (Onsite – 4 days in office)

At CHAMP
, we are redefining the technology used by Motor Vehicle Agencies and their stakeholders. We do so with innovative, cloud-based software that enhances efficiency, security, and interoperability. Our solutions replace outdated processes with modern, scalable platforms, enabling organizations to operate with greater speed and accuracy in an increasingly digital world.

The Internship

At CHAMP
, our mission is to give interns a hands-on, immersive, and collaborative experience where their work contributes to real business goals. From day one, you’ll take on a project connected to CHAMP
’s current priorities, build practical skills alongside our team, and share your accomplishments at an intern showcase at the end of the 10-week program.

You’ll have a dedicated buddy and mentor to support you along the way, plus opportunities to connect face-to-face with executives and senior leaders. CHAMP
also hosts lunch & learns twice a month that interns are invited to attend.

A midpoint evaluation will help you understand your strengths, identify opportunities for growth, and set priorities for the remainder of the program. A final evaluation will reflect on your contributions, progress, and continued development.

Building connections is part of the experience, too. Each summer program includes multiple social events, including a summer party and a Cleveland Guardians game. These gatherings give you time to get to know fellow interns and CHAMP
employees beyond your day-to-day work, build friendships, and feel part of the CHAMP
community.

Join a company recognized as #379 on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500
, one of Forbes’ America’s Best Startup Employers for 2026
, and a member of the 2026 Inc. Regionals Midwest list
. We’re investing in our future and yours, with the goal of creating opportunities for interns to continue with CHAMP
through an extended internship or a full-time role.

Your Impact

As a Frontend Software Engineering Intern, you’ll work alongside CHAMP
’s Product Engineering team to build and improve the user-facing features of our software. You’ll help turn ideas and designs into functional, intuitive interfaces while gaining hands-on experience with frontend development, including React and TypeScript. Your work will contribute to modern web applications that help replace outdated government systems.

What You’ll Do

Work on a defined frontend software engineering project with real business impact.
Help develop, test, and improve user interfaces alongside experienced engineers.
Translate product requirements and designs into functional web features.
Learn and apply frontend technologies within CHAMP
’s stack, including React and TypeScript.
Help connect user interfaces to backend services and display information clearly.
Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging to improve software quality.
Collaborate with engineering, product, design, and QA teammates throughout your project.
Document your work and communicate progress, questions, and challenges.
Apply feedback and explore new approaches as you develop your technical skills.

Required Qualifications

Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, software engineering, or a related field.
Available to complete a 10-week internship of approximately 40 hours per week in Cleveland from early June through early August 2027.
Academic or hands-on experience with at least one programming language.
Foundational understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Strong problem-solving skills and an interest in building intuitive user experiences.
Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a team.
Curiosity and a willingness to learn new technologies, ask questions, and incorporate feedback.
Comfort working through ambiguity and researching unfamiliar concepts.

Preferred Qualifications

Exposure to React, TypeScript, or a similar frontend technology.
Experience building a website or web application through coursework, personal projects, internships, or hackathons.
Familiarity with APIs, version-control tools such as Git, or software testing.
Interest in frontend engineering, responsive design, accessibility, or user experience.

Our Values

Our values guide how we work and grow: Excellence Always, Better Together, No is a Stumbling Block on the Way to Yes,
and Set the Standard.
As an intern, you’ll put these values into practice by taking pride in the quality of your work, sharing ideas and learning from others, approaching challenges with curiosity and persistence, and finding ways to improve how we work. You’ll have the support of teammates who will help you learn, contribute, and build confidence along the way.

Hourly Rate

The expected hourly rate for this position is $22.50 per hour. This is a good-faith estimate, and financial compensation may vary based on experience and skills.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, including veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We’re here to help.

By joining CHAMP
, you will be an integral member of our team, with many opportunities for personal growth and upward mobility in a growing organization. We have a culture that is flexible, collaborative, and welcoming.

Implement unit tests and stubs for legacy Ada modules using GNAT Pro Enterprise Ada and the AUnit testing framework.

, we are redefining the technology used by Motor Vehicle Agencies and their stakeholders. We do so with innovative, cloud-based software that enhances efficiency, security, and interoperability. Our solutions replace outdated processes with modern, scalable platforms, enabling organizations to operate with greater speed and accuracy in an increasingly digital world.

The Internship

At CHAMP
, our mission is to give interns a hands-on, immersive, and collaborative experience where their work contributes to real business goals. From day one, you’ll take on a project connected to CHAMP
’s current priorities, build practical skills alongside our team, and share your accomplishments at an intern showcase at the end of the 10-week program.

You’ll have a dedicated buddy and mentor to support you along the way, plus opportunities to connect face-to-face with executives and senior leaders. CHAMP
also hosts lunch & learns twice a month that interns are invited to attend.

A midpoint evaluation will help you understand your strengths, identify opportunities for growth, and set priorities for the remainder of the program. A final evaluation will reflect on your contributions, progress, and continued development.

Building connections is part of the experience, too. Each summer program includes multiple social events, including a summer party and a Cleveland Guardians game. These gatherings give you time to get to know fellow interns and CHAMP
employees beyond your day-to-day work, build friendships, and feel part of the CHAMP
community.

Join a company recognized as #379 on the Deloitte Technology Fast 500
, one of Forbes’ America’s Best Startup Employers for 2026
, and a member of the 2026 Inc. Regionals Midwest list
. We’re investing in our future and yours, with the goal of creating opportunities for interns to continue with CHAMP
through an extended internship or a full-time role.

Your Impact

As a Backend Software Engineering Intern, you’ll work alongside CHAMP
’s Product Engineering team on meaningful projects that contribute to our technology and business. You’ll help develop the backend services, APIs, and application logic that power CHAMP
’s products, primarily using Java and Spring Boot. You’ll apply what you’ve learned in the classroom to real-world challenges and see how your work supports CHAMP
’s technology and business.

What You’ll Do

Work on a defined backend software engineering project with real business impact.
Design, develop, test, and maintain backend software alongside experienced engineers.
Write and test code primarily using Java and Spring Boot.
Help build and enhance APIs and backend services that support CHAMP
’s products.
Apply software engineering concepts, including data structures, algorithms, APIs, object-oriented programming, and software design principles.
Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and other stages of the software development lifecycle.
Collaborate with engineers, product teams, fellow interns, and other stakeholders throughout your project.
Participate in team meetings and communicate project progress, challenges, and results.

Required Qualifications

Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, software engineering, or a related field.
Available to complete a 10-week internship of approximately 40 hours per week in Cleveland from early June through early August 2027.
Academic or hands-on experience with at least one programming language, along with a willingness to learn and work in Java.
Foundational understanding of software engineering concepts, data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented programming.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively within a team.
Curiosity and a willingness to learn new technologies, ask questions, and incorporate feedback.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Java, Spring Boot, or the Spring Framework.
Experience with REST APIs, SQL, databases, or cloud technologies.
Familiarity with Python for scripting or automation.
Previous technical experience through coursework, internships, hackathons, research, or personal projects.
Familiarity with Git or other version-control tools.
Interest in backend development and working in a fast-paced, collaborative software company.

Our Values

Our values guide how we work and grow: Excellence Always, Better Together, No is a Stumbling Block on the Way to Yes,
and Set the Standard.
As an intern, you’ll put these values into practice by taking pride in the quality of your work, sharing ideas and learning from others, approaching challenges with curiosity and persistence, and finding ways to improve how we work. You’ll have the support of teammates who will help you learn, contribute, and build confidence along the way.

Hourly Rate

The expected hourly rate for this position is $22.50 per hour. This is a good-faith estimate, and financial compensation may vary based on experience and skills.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, including veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you need accommodations during the application or interview process, please let us know. We’re here to help.

By joining CHAMP
, you will be an integral member of our team, with many opportunities for personal growth and upward mobility in a growing organization. We have a culture that is flexible, collaborative, and welcoming.

Work directly with spacecraft systems, solve complex integration challenges, and help shape software used in real satellite missions.

jobs.title: Software Engineer — Governance Platform & Enablement
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

We are a core Governance Engineering team within the TikTok USDS Joint Venture, enabling data protection, software assurance, content assurance, and governance efficiency for hundreds of millions of U.S. users.

We build and operate scalable privacy and compliance platforms, governance workflows, systems of record, evidence management, code intelligence, and shared services. Through platform engineering, end-to-end development, Agentic automation, developer-first tooling, and applied research, we turn complex governance requirements into reliable, scalable, and auditable solutions.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to build and evolve GPCP (Global Privacy Compliance Platform), applications and reusable shared services that help Security and Privacy teams put governance requirements into practice across complex systems and workflows.

You’ll work across frontend and backend systems, developing intuitive user experiences, scalable backend services, APIs, integrations, and reusable platform components. Depending on your strengths, you may focus more deeply on application development or backend platform capabilities while contributing to end-to-end solutions.

You’ll own features from technical design through production, helping GPCP and its shared foundations become more extensible, reliable, and intelligent.

Responsibilities
- Build GPCP and shared services. Develop scalable full-stack applications, backend services, APIs, and integrations supporting compliance workflows, evidence management, and cross-system operations.
- Develop reusable platform capabilities. Build shared APIs, SDKs, UI components, domain models, data contracts, and integration frameworks to accelerate application development and onboarding while leveraging existing systems of record.
- Modernize platform architecture. Simplify dependencies and improve scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability through backward-compatible migrations.
- Enable governance workflows and intelligent automation. Build workflow automation, evidence integrations, and AI-powered tools that improve operational efficiency, traceability, and audit readiness.
- Own end-to-end delivery. Translate requirements into technical designs and documentation; implement, test, deploy, monitor, and support production services.
- Champion engineering excellence and security. Apply secure SDLC, authentication and authorization, API security, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, and observability practices.
- Collaborate across teams. Partner with Privacy, Security, Legal, Operations, Product, and engineering teams to deliver reliable, extensible solutions.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- Experience building and maintaining production applications or backend services, with proficiency in at least one programming language such as Go, Java, Python, or TypeScript/JavaScript.
- Solid understanding of API design, service integration, and application architecture.
- Experience with data modeling, relational or NoSQL databases, and data-access patterns.
- Experience developing reliable backend services or complex frontend applications using modern frameworks such as React, with an understanding of API integration and production performance.
- Experience delivering features end to end, including design, automated testing, CI/CD, deployment, and production support.
- Ability to translate complex business requirements into maintainable technical solutions and collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience building full-stack applications with React, TypeScript, reusable UI components, design systems, or complex data-intensive interfaces.
- Experience building enterprise platforms, workflow systems, case management applications, risk management solutions, or complex internal tools.
- Familiarity with domain-driven design, state machines, or event-driven architectures.
- Experience building reusable platform APIs, SDKs, or integration frameworks, with familiarity in technologies such as GraphQL, gRPC, OAuth 2.0, SSO, or RBAC.
- Experience integrating AI-powered applications, LLMs, agents, MCP-compatible tools, or intelligent automation into production systems.
- Familiarity with privacy, security, compliance, governance, or enterprise risk management workflows.
- Experience with cloud platforms such as Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), container orchestration technologies such as Kubernetes, infrastructure automation, observability, or large-scale distributed systems.

About USDS

TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/USDS-RA​

Responsibilities

The TikTok U.S. Data Security (USDS) team is responsible for the security, integrity, and compliance of TikTok data in the United States. The Data Platform Team builds reliable and cost-efficient infrastructure, self-service tools, and data products that help business and engineering teams work effectively.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to grow their backend engineering skills while contributing to AI-powered internal products. You will work on clearly scoped projects with guidance from experienced engineers, learn the team’s systems and development practices, and gradually take ownership of production-ready components.

Responsibilities
- Implement, test, and maintain well-scoped backend services, APIs, and internal platform components with guidance from experienced engineers.
- Contribute to AI-powered product capabilities such as data services, workflow automation, model integrations, and internal tools by following established designs and engineering practices.
- Work with engineers, data scientists, and business partners to understand requirements, clarify edge cases, and deliver practical solutions.
- Write clear, maintainable code and participate in code reviews, design discussions, testing, deployment, and production support.
- Learn the team’s architecture, development processes, and operational standards, and apply feedback to improve technical judgment and execution.
- Take increasing ownership of small features or components, communicate progress and blockers early, and deliver work within agreed scope and timelines.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications
- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, completed recently or expected before the start date.
- Programming foundations: Proficiency in at least one backend programming language such as Python, Go, Java, or Node.js, demonstrated through coursework, internships, research, or personal projects.
- Computer science fundamentals: Understanding of data structures, algorithms, object-oriented or functional programming, and basic software design principles.
- Backend fundamentals: Familiarity with APIs, databases, testing, version control, and common client-server concepts.
- Learning and collaboration: Ability to learn unfamiliar systems, ask clear questions, incorporate feedback, and work effectively with teammates.

Preferred Qualifications
- AI Systems Exposure: Coursework, internship, research, or project experience using LLM APIs, RAG pipelines, model-serving tools, or agentic workflows; interest in learning how to build reliable and safe AI-powered systems.
- System Design Foundations: Understanding of modular design, API design, testing, and maintainable code, with the ability to discuss basic trade-offs and apply feedback from experienced engineers.
- Collaboration and Growth: Strong communication and teamwork skills, curiosity about user needs, and the ability to take ownership of well-scoped tasks or small features with appropriate guidance.

About USDS

TikTok USDS Joint Venture LLC is dedicated to the safety and security of millions of Americans who create, discover, and connect with what they love on the apps we operate. The Joint Venture has been established in compliance with the Executive Order signed by President Trump on September 25, 2025. Our foundation is a comprehensive data privacy and cybersecurity program we operate under defined safeguards to protect national security and secure U.S. user data, apps and the algorithm. We safeguard the U.S. content ecosystem, holding decision-making authority for trust and safety policies and moderation. USDS Joint Venture helps ensure Americans can continue to express their creativity, discover new hobbies and interests, and build thriving communities and businesses on a global scale.​
​
On-site presence across teams allows the company to operate with greater speed, alignment, and agility — especially in areas like real-time decision-making, team development, and integrated execution. As such, the company is shifting from a hybrid work model to a fully in-person schedule up to 5 days a week.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

About CFD Research:
Since its inception in 1987, CFD Research has delivered innovative technology solutions within the Aerospace & Defense, Biomedical & Life Sciences, Intelligence & Sensing, and Energy & Materials industries. Magazine's Inc5000 as a top growing company for four of the last five years. Learn more at www.cfd-research.com

CFD Research is seeking an Ada Software Test Engineer to develop and execute automated unit test suites for mission-critical software on an advanced Missile Defense system. The engineer will implement unit tests, isolation stubs, and interface wrappers for legacy components and multi-language bindings, driving rigorous code coverage and verification across key system capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

Implement unit tests and stubs for legacy Ada modules using GNAT Pro Enterprise Ada and the AUnit testing framework.
Build mocks to isolate dependencies involving OIS Ada ORB middleware and legacy IPC interfaces.
Validate and maintain multi-language interface bindings where Ada components interact directly with native C/C++ libraries.
Perform systematic branch and statement test analyses to reach and maintain 80% code coverage.

Qualifications And Desired Skills

U.S. Citizenship required; must possess and maintain an active DoD SECRET Clearance
Strong proficiency in Ada 95/2005 development, debugging, and testing.
Hands-on experience with GNAT Pro Enterprise Ada (v20 / 26.1) and the AUnit test framework.
Experience with mixed-language systems (Ada-to-C/C++ bindings) and OIS Ada ORB middleware.
Experience executing unit-level testing on mission-critical DoD embedded software baselines.

area
,

AfterQuery is looking for experts with experience in software engineering, computer science, or app/web development to help train and evaluate AI models. This is a remote, project-based role: qualify once through a single assessment and receive ongoing project matches spanning code review, evaluation, and original task creation. Pay ranges from $50 to $100/hour depending on the projects you qualify into.

Why Apply

Competitive Pay: $50–$100/hour across the project pool
One Assessment, Ongoing Matches: qualify once, get matched to projects continuously
Flexible Engagement: fully remote and asynchronous, on your own schedule

Responsibilities

Complete software engineering tasks across a range of AI training and evaluation projects
Review and evaluate code and model outputs for correctness and quality
Deliver clear, well-documented work independently

Required Qualifications

2+ years of real-world software engineering experience (full-time or substantive internships count)
Strong fundamentals in at least one major programming language
Reliable, detail-oriented, and able to work independently

Company Description

AfterQuery
is a research lab investigating the boundaries of artificial intelligence through novel datasets and experimentation. We're backed by top investors, including Y Combinator and Box Group, and support all leading AI labs.

Job Description
Opportunity Snapshot

Time per task:
5 hours for trainers and 1.5 hours for reviewers
Engagement:
Project-based — paid per approved task
Commitment:
~15 hours per week
Location:
Fully remote
You’ll need:
Hands-on expertise in at least one of Python, Java, Rust, Go, C++, or TypeScript
Your tasks:
Build challenging coding problems from real repositories, with reproducible environments and verifiers

You’ll create Reinforcement Learning Environments that test a model’s ability to solve real software engineering problems: tracking down subtle bugs, building non-trivial features, refactoring, and optimizing performance. Each task means defining the problem, building a reproducible environment, and writing a reference solution.

Scope of Work

Create realistic, challenging coding tasks for frontier AI models, drawn from repositories you know well.
Design problems that require real engineering skill — subtle bugs, non-trivial features, meaningful performance work — not lookup or boilerplate.
Build a reproducible environment for each task.
Write deterministic verifiers that accept correct solutions across different valid implementations, while rejecting incorrect, incomplete, or hard-coded approaches.
Provide a reference solution showing how the task can be solved.
Flag tasks that turn out to be ambiguous or unverifiable rather than submitting them.

Preferred Qualifications

Significant hands-on expertise in at least one of: Python3, Java, Rust, Go, C++, or TypeScript.
Deep understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software engineering principles.
Proven ability to debug complex systems, resolve bugs, and deliver effective optimizations.
Experience with large codebase refactoring and legacy system modernization.
Track record of delivering high-impact features from conception through delivery.
Strong documentation and communication skills to articulate technical concepts clearly.
Interest in AI and its technical challenges — previous AI experience not required.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required may vary depending on your experience and workflow.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.
